envelope.description: Adapt accepted findings to versioned canonical review records

body.title: Adapt accepted findings to versioned canonical review records
body.summary: Add completion-artifact.ts and extend canonical CodeReviewBody with investigation grounding and compact versioned linkage. Reuse or extract runner count/verdict/build validation without invoking judges; update necessary internal type guards while retaining legacy full/degraded behavior.
acceptanceChecks: All accepted findings retain criterion, severity, confidence, evidence/expectation identity and accountable locations; unknown or unmappable dimensions refuse rather than drop.
HIGH yields block, MED warn and LOW pass under existing code-review fold; source-only/indexed investigation inputs have the same verdict policy.
New investigation records require version/sourceMode/run/subject/policy/checkpoint/coverage/operation linkage; legacy records remain readable with their existing degraded warn cap.
Metadata records authenticated reviewer and reviewed BUILD fingerprint/revision; no raw ledger/evidence collection embedded in artifact JSON.
No judge rerun, automatic approval or external tool registration.

tests.name: Canonical investigation adaptation preserves finding identity severity and confidence
Investigation mode parity and legacy full degraded verdict compatibility
